Get a mini-audit

What the initial check covers

The free mini-audit establishes a starting point before we discuss promotion. I choose a small set of questions about buying a product or selecting a provider and examine which businesses appear in the answers. This gives our conversation concrete material: buyer questions, AI responses and the sources used to describe the business.

The scope is up to 5 prompts, up to 5 AI platforms and a report of up to 3 pages. The turnaround is 1 working day. Questions reflect your priority service, market and customer type. For a business with a large catalog, we begin with the area that matters most to you now.

What you learn from the report

I review whether the brand appears in the selected answers and how it is described. A recommendation, a brand mention and a source link mean different things. An AI answer might cite your article while suggesting another company as the supplier.

A small sample provides initial findings. It helps us decide which questions need deeper investigation, whether business information is accurate and which sources deserve attention. Comparing a whole industry or several product areas requires a broader prompt matrix.

How I measure BMR and assess recommendations →

Information to include in your enquiry

Send your website address, company name and a short description of what you sell and to whom. Include your main region or market. If the priority is a particular service, new product or property, identify it in the enquiry so the questions reflect that objective.

You can add 2–3 competitors and an example of a question your customers ask. I use this context when choosing prompts. Questions that already name your brand are considered separately from questions in which the AI platform independently recommends a business.

GAEO approaches by industry →

Choosing the next step

After the check, we discuss the findings and your goals: which services should appear more often, what material already exists and who can implement website changes. A full GEO audit is suitable when you need a detailed plan. It covers more prompts and platforms, examines the business and produces a plan for further work.

If the objective and starting information are already clear, we can discuss monthly promotion. The format also depends on whether your team can create content from my briefs or you want GAEO to produce the material.

Full GEO audit and action plan →Promotion with briefs for your team →Promotion with content creation →
FAQ

Questions about this service

How many prompts does the free audit include?+
Up to 5 representative prompts across up to 5 AI platforms. The questions are selected for a specific service, audience and market.
When will I receive the findings?+
The mini-audit takes 1 working day. Findings are delivered in a report of up to 3 pages.
How does it differ from a full audit?+
The mini-audit provides initial findings from a small sample. A full audit includes up to 100 prompts, up to 11 AI platforms, a business review, a 25–35-page report and a GEO action plan.
Can the mini-audit predict future sales?+
It shows AI answers to selected questions. Assessing enquiries and sales requires separate business data and observation of promotion results over time.
